hooks.command:
python3 -c '
import json, re, sys
cmd = json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input", {}).get("command", "")
flag = "--delete" + "-branch"
pat = re.compile(r"(?<!\S)(" + re.escape(flag) + r"|-d)(?!\S)")
for seg in re.split(r"[;&|\n]+", cmd):
    if "gh pr merge" in seg and pat.search(seg):
        sys.stderr.write("BLOCKED: deleting the branch inside gh pr merge has already closed a PR unmerged. Merge first, verify with: gh pr view <n> --json state,mergedAt — then delete the branch as a separate step.\n")
        sys.exit(2)
sys.exit(0)
'

git status --short 2>/dev/null; b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$b" ] && exit 0; if git rev-parse --verify -q "origin/$b" >/dev/null 2>&1; then u=$(git log "origin/$b..HEAD" --oneline 2>/dev/null | head -5); [ -n "$u" ] && printf '%s\n^ UNPUSHED COMMITS on %s — task is NOT DONE\n' "$u" "$b"; else echo "^ branch $b has no remote tracking ref — nothing was ever pushed"; fi; exit 0

soft_deny: Bash(gh pr merge:*) with --admin or --delete-branch — keep merges as an explicit two-step: merge, verify with gh pr view, then delete the branch
Bash(rm:*) inside git worktree directories — scope destructive deletes to review
environment: **Primary use of Claude Code**: software development on personal projects
**Repository visibility**: check with gh; personal repos under github.com/lx-wnk are often PUBLIC, so nothing confidential may be committed there
**Default / protected branches**: main is protected; never push directly to it
**Source control**: the current repo and its origin remote only
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: none — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: any file or store holding personal data, credentials or confidential business data; ~/.config/claude/*.env holds secrets and is never printed or committed
**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host or container whose name carries `prod` or `production` as a whole word or name segment
